development area: Client needs diagnostics and request triage
description: Ability to decompose user requests, distinguish underlying information needs from requested products, and triage options using structured criteria.
historic work: Key Activities - Provides custom tabulations and time-series information for ad-hoc client requests.
change to work: Ad-hoc service provision will become more controlled and diagnostic. Instead of moving directly to fulfilling requests, the incumbent will first validate need, assess whether the request can be met from existing outputs or reusable assets, estimate cost and timeliness implications, and determine whether the request should proceed, be reframed, or be redirected. The role becomes more selective and evidence-based in responding to client demand.
justification: The current activity implies a responsive service model; the future state requires screening and reframing requests based on digital discovery and evidence.
